items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records that a totally acyclic sheaf is right acyclic for four functors: the section functor at an object, evaluation on a presheaf of sets, global sections, and pushforward along a morphism of ringed topoi (statement lines 2272-2285). The proof applies the criterion of the section characterizing total acyclicity to each of the four functors (proof lines 2287-2302), the last two being handled by the same computation. The non-formal content is the reading of the criterion in the four cases. The claim is H2: four applications of one criterion.
